name: VERD-IE
summary: Zariman の植物を世話する保守ドローン
> “The Vegetation and Environment Regulation Drone - Independent Element faithfully maintained Zariman greenery even after all was lost and is thrilled to have company once again.”
> VERD-IE or Vegetation and Environment Regulation Drone - Independent Element are maintenance drones that tend to the agri-biomes and vegetation aboard the Zariman Ten Zero.
> A VERD-IE Sentinel skin can be purchased from Hombask in the Chrysalith for 60,000, with related mask, tail, and wing attachments for 10,000 each.
sections: Outfitted with a personal pair of gardening shears and hose, the VERD-IE drones were created by the Orokin to tend to the numerous agri-biomes and vegetation all around the Zariman. After the ship was lost within the Void and the agri-biomes vented into space, the drones worked tirelessly to reseal and replant them, and now are awaiting the next harvest.
- A specific VERD-IE unit, named PRIMM, can be found accompanying Hombask, and will occasionally make chattering and beeping sounds.
- "VERD-IE" is derived from the word "verdant" meaning "lush with green vegetation."
